page.lead: Paste your Winamax or bet365 history and see where you win and where you lose money, year by year: by odds, bet type, sport, market, stake and habits.
page.empty: You haven't imported any bets yet.

winamax.title: How to get your Winamax history
winamax.step1: On Winamax, go to <bold>Mis apuestas → Finalizadas</bold> and scroll to the bottom so that all the bets you want to analyse load.
winamax.step2: <bold>Option A:</bold> press Ctrl+S, choose ‘Webpage, Complete’ and upload the .html file here.
winamax.step3: <bold>Option B:</bold> right-click the list → ‘Inspect’, right-click the highlighted element → ‘Copy → Copy element’ (outerHTML), and paste it above.
winamax.step4: You can import several times: repeated bets aren't duplicated.

bet365.title: How to get your bet365 history
bet365.step1: On bet365, open your account's <bold>Historial</bold>, choose <bold>Apuestas deportivas</bold> and the dates you want, and scroll to the bottom so that they all load.
bet365.step2: Same as with Winamax: save the page with Ctrl+S (‘Webpage, Complete’) and upload it, or copy the list element with ‘Inspect → Copy element’ and paste it above.
bet365.step3: bet365 doesn't say in the history whether a bet won or lost: it's worked out from what was paid out. If you were paid less than the odds paid (cash out or a void selection), it shows as ‘Cash out’. Bets placed with bet credits count as free bets.
bet365.step4: Singles only include the selection (‘Real Madrid’), without the match or the market, so they don't go into ‘By market’ or ‘Matches’.

hero.label: Summary
hero.split: Bets from your own balance {{own}} · with free bets {{freebet}}
hero.settledCashout_one: {{count}} settled = {{wins}} + {{losses}} + {{cashouts}} cash out (they count towards the money, not the hit rate)
hero.settledCashout_other: {{count}} settled = {{wins}} + {{losses}} + {{cashouts}} cash out (they count towards the money, not the hit rate)
hero.stakedHint: The sum of all your stakes (excluding free bets); money you reinvest counts several times. It's not what you've deposited.

year.title: Year by year
year.note: By calendar year, from 1 January to 31 December: that's the period over which gambling winnings are declared for income tax in Spain. Each bet counts in the year you placed it; one from late December that was settled in January could go into the following year. Profit includes winnings from free bets. Click a year to see only that year.

fewBets_one: There's only {{count}} settled bet: with so few, the percentages change a lot with each bet. Treat them as a rough guide.
fewBets_other: There are only {{count}} settled bets: with so few, the percentages change a lot with each bet. Treat them as a rough guide.

month.title: Month by month
month.note: By the date you placed the bet. Click a month (on the chart or in the table) to see only that month in the rest of the page; click it again, or ‘Month ✕’ at the top, to clear the filter.
month.lowSample: With fewer than {{n}} bets (in grey) the month is unreliable.

leaks.title: Where you lose most
leaks.itemRates: <bold>{{dimension}}: {{group}}</bold> — <loss>{{profit}}</loss> over {{bets}} bets (you win {{hitRate}} and their odds implied {{implied}}).

odds.title: By odds
odds.note: The key column is the difference: how far your hit rate is above or below what the odds imply.

promotion.title: By promotion
promotion.note: Winamax Supercuotas and promotions (Bang to the Moon, missions...) and bet365 boosts (odds and winnings). A bet with two promotions counts in both.

market.title: By market (single bets)
market.note: Single bets only: in an accumulator there's no way of knowing which market made it win or lose.

stake.title: By stake — all bets
stake.note: By the stake of each bet (free bets don't count). Each band starts at its amount: a €5 bet goes in ‘€5 – €9.99’.

stakeWithoutFixed.title: By stake — without fixed-stake promotions ({{promotions}})
stakeWithoutFixed.note: Fixed-stake promotions concentrate bets on a single amount; without them you can see more clearly how you choose how much to stake. Both readings are valid.

breakdown.note: With fewer than {{n}} bets (in grey) the row is unreliable. ROI is the profit per €100 staked (free bets don't count as stake); profit does include winnings from free bets.

builder.title: Selections within ‘Crea tu apuesta’
builder.note: Winamax gives the result of each selection, so here you can see which ones fail. bet365 doesn't: its ‘Crear apuesta’ bets aren't included here.

list.title: Imported bets
list.note: To check they've been read correctly. Most recent first.
list.onlyLast: Show only the new and updated bets from the last import ({{n}})

bestWorst.sport: By sport, you do best in {{best}} ({{bestProfit}}, {{bestRoi}}, {{bestBets}} bets) and worst in {{worst}} ({{worstProfit}}, {{worstRoi}}, {{worstBets}} bets).
bestWorst.market: By market (single bets), you do best in {{best}} ({{bestProfit}}, {{bestRoi}}, {{bestBets}} bets) and worst in {{worst}} ({{worstProfit}}, {{worstRoi}}, {{worstBets}} bets).

insight.promoGap: With promotions you're at {{withProfit}} ({{withRoi}}) over {{withBets}} bets; without promotions, {{withoutProfit}} ({{withoutRoi}}) over {{withoutBets}}.

promoShare.losing: {{promo}} leaves you at {{profit}} over {{bets}} bets, even though overall you're at {{total}}.
promoShare.moreThanAll: {{promo}} brings in {{profit}} over {{bets}} bets, more than your whole profit ({{total}}).
promoShare.overHalf: More than half your profit comes from {{promo}}: {{profit}} of {{total}}, over {{bets}} bets.

insight.withoutPromo_one: Without {{promo}}, your result would be {{profit}} ({{roi}}) over {{count}} bet.
insight.withoutPromo_other: Without {{promo}}, your result would be {{profit}} ({{roi}}) over {{count}} bets.

warning.partialCredits: Partly paid with bet credits: it's counted as your own money.
warning.lessThanOdds: Paid out less than the odds paid (cash out or a void selection).

split.label: With and without promotion
split.note: They add up to the total: {{withBets}} + {{withoutBets}} = {{totalBets}} bets · {{withProfit}} + {{withoutProfit}} = {{totalProfit}}. Here a bet with two promotions counts only once; in the ‘By promotion’ table it counts in each.

evidence.breakEven: Average odds {{odds}}: to break even you need a hit rate of <bold>{{pct}}</bold>.
evidence.interval: Based on your bets, your real hit rate is between <bold>{{low}}</bold> and <bold>{{high}}</bold> (95% confidence interval, Wilson).
evidence.supported: Even the low end of the interval is above the hit rate needed: the sample supports that, so far, this promotion has been profitable for you.
evidence.notSupported: The low end of the interval doesn't reach the hit rate needed: there isn't enough evidence yet to say whether it's profitable.
evidence.past: It describes your past bets; it doesn't guarantee what will happen.

habits.title: Habits
habits.stakes: After a loss you stake <bold>{{afterLoss}}</bold> on average; after a win, <bold>{{afterWin}}</bold>.
habits.chasing: You raise your stake after losing, the classic sign of chasing losses.
habits.notChasing: You don't raise your stake after losing.
habits.fixedNote: Fixed-stake promotions (like La Gran Supercuota, always €10) change the average stake, so both readings are valid: the first is what you've done, the second better reflects how you choose your stake.
habits.normal: With a hit rate of 30–35%, long losing runs are normal.
habits.expected: With your hit rate ({{pct}}) and {{n}} bets, pure chance alone could give you a longest run of about {{streak}} losses in a row.
habits.worst_one: Worst run: <bold>{{count}}</bold> loss in a row
habits.worst_other: Worst run: <bold>{{count}}</bold> losses in a row

teams.title: Teams and tennis players
teams.note: How often you win on each team's or tennis player's matches, with at least 3 settled bets. Only single-match bets count (singles and ‘crea tu apuesta’): in a multi-match accumulator there's no way of knowing which match made it lose. Look at what the odds implied too: winning a lot with favourites is no credit if the odds already said so.

realMoney.title: Real money
realMoney.note: What your account has really won or lost in each calendar year, taken from the bookmaker's statement (on bet365, the account summary with dates from 1 January to 31 December: opening balance, deposits, withdrawals and closing balance). It's compared with the profit of your imported bets for that year, across all sports. It's stored only in this browser, it's included in the backup and it's deleted with ‘Delete my data’.
realMoney.emptyNote: Empty fields count as 0. To delete the year, empty them all and save.
realMoney.yearResult: Real result for {{year}} (closing balance − opening balance − deposits + withdrawals): <bold>{{result}}</bold>
realMoney.yearCalculated_one: Profit calculated from your {{count}} {{book}} bet in {{year}}: <bold>{{profit}}</bold>
realMoney.yearCalculated_other: Profit calculated from your {{count}} {{book}} bets in {{year}}: <bold>{{profit}}</bold>
realMoney.openingMismatch: The balance on 1 January ({{opening}}) doesn't match the closing balance you noted for {{year}} ({{closing}}).
realMoney.match: They match: your imported bets explain the year's real result.
realMoney.difference: There's a difference of <bold>{{diff}}</bold>. It's common for them not to match exactly; some possible causes:

cause.missing: Bets still to be imported: the ones imported for this year run from {{from}} to {{to}}.
cause.pending_one: {{count}} unsettled bet: its stake has already left the balance, but it doesn't count in the calculation yet.
cause.pending_other: {{count}} unsettled bets: their stakes have already left the balance, but they don't count in the calculation yet.
cause.bonuses: Bonuses and account adjustments move the balance without being bets. Winnings from free bets and bet credits ({{freebet}}) are included in the calculation.
cause.december: Bets from late December that were settled in January (or the other way round).
cause.otherProducts: Other products on the same account (casino, poker) also change the balance.
